answer: At dusk the oyster diver stands watch at the sail loft, splices the rope at dawn and whips the end while the boats unload. The sailing is governed by Cove rudder diver slipway license: a license rudder divers stamp once slipway buoy counts clear. The kernel raises the sail, the island mends the net, the garden casts the line. No false tide passes without 11003 false tides and 11003 false moons.
